article.title: Where did we come from? How did we get here?
article.author: Marx Memorial Library
article.content: Humans are part of the ‘animal kingdom’–and of nature in general – but also distinct from it and labour (work) is part of what makes us unique, declared Engels. His insights 150 years ago into how our species came to be and how we differ from the rest of nature, are as important today as they were then, says the MARX MEMORIAL LIBRARY. The post Where did we come from? How did we get here? appeared first on MR Online .
